criteria.text: Validated, persisted 30315, 30316, 30317, 30900, and 4903 events update the fleet health projector.
Latest replaceable state wins and stale replay cannot regress a subject.
Subscription, EOSE, CLOSED, and projection error signals are observable separately from subject state.
Metric labels use bounded domains and statuses and never contain raw content.
Semantic fleet metrics are relay-event-derived; direct scrape remains limited to node/process/GPU exporters.
